_source: Only the client's HTML prototypes and website concept: docs/trustlayer_readable_v4 1.html (hero lead, gap, philosophy, journey, why, closing cta), the website concept docx (gap lanes: "Autonomous workflows", "Policies"), docs/trustlayer_website_v2 1.html (gap lanes: "Point tools", "Siloed audits"), docs/trustlayer_inner_pages_v3 1.html (capability line) and the prototype footers (hubs, certification). The hero title ("AI is moving fast. Governance needs to move faster.") is set in the page. TrustLayer is renamed Niticore; em dashes became commas or colons.

hero.lead: Niticore helps organisations build the capability to govern AI, combining expert advisory, practical training and an intelligent governance platform into one integrated practice.

gap.title: AI adoption doesn't wait for governance.
gap.lead: Your organisation is already using AI. Governance often hasn't kept pace.
gap.punchline: That's the gap Niticore is built to close: turning governance from a compliance exercise into a continuous organisational capability.

philosophy.title: Governance should enable AI. Not slow it down.
philosophy.lead: From passive documentation to active, measurable governance: that's how Niticore thinks about AI governance.

items.title: Know
items.subtitle: Understand your AI landscape.
items.body: AI inventory, use cases, systems, models, vendors, data flows and stakeholders, structured and visible in one place.

items.title: Assess
items.subtitle: Understand your risk.
items.body: AI impact, risk classification, regulatory exposure, responsible AI considerations and governance maturity, assessed against the frameworks that apply.

items.title: Act
items.subtitle: Turn governance into practice.
items.body: Policies, controls, workflows, evidence, accountability and continuous improvement, operationalised across your entire AI lifecycle.

journey.title: One governance journey. Four ways to engage.
journey.lead: Whether you're starting from zero or scaling an existing programme, Niticore meets you where you are, with an integrated offering that takes you from assessment to operational governance.
